title: S-4 facility: hand scanner, corridor and nine hangars

tellings.quote: access. And there were nine hangars, so

plain: A secret site called S-4, near Papoose Lake in the Nevada desert, had a hand scanner controlling access, a corridor, and nine hangars, according to a man named Bob Lazar, who says he worked there in 1988 and 1989. Lazar describes it to Michels as something he saw himself ("And there were nine hangars") and mentions a man named Dennis Mariani in connection with it. If true, it would describe a hidden base the public was never told about.
